# Fazed Digital

> Web design, branding and SEO studio in Iligan City, Lanao del Norte, Philippines (est. 2022). Websites, brands and web apps for clients in the USA, Australia and the Philippines. 120+ projects delivered since 2022.

- Not affiliated with Faze Digital (London), Faze47 Digital, Fuze Digital or FZP Digital. Fazed Digital is the studio at www.fazeddigital.com.
- Team (4): Lord Arcamo (Founder), Reancirl Balaba (Co-Founder), Russel Heyrana (Marketing Director), Justin Sumaya (Head of Development) · https://www.fazeddigital.com/about
- Languages: English, Bisaya (Cebuano) and Tagalog. Meets clients in person in Iligan City and Cagayan de Oro; works online worldwide.
- Payment: GCash, Maya, bank transfer (BPI, Metrobank) and Wise.
- Contact: info@fazeddigital.com · +63 906 825 3451 · Mon–Fri 8:30am–5:00pm PHT · https://www.fazeddigital.com/contact
- 7-day website package: Starter $499 / Growth $899 / Pro $1,499 (PHP: ₱19,999 / ₱34,999 / ₱59,999). Starter = 5 pages, 2 revision rounds; Growth = 8 pages + blog/CMS, 3 rounds; Pro = 10+ pages, e-commerce ready, unlimited revisions. Delivery in 7 business days, or 20% off the project fee. The client owns the domain, hosting, logins and files.
- Custom websites and systems: typically $5,000–$20,000 depending on scope.

## Services
- [Web design & development](https://www.fazeddigital.com/services#web): A website that brings in enquiries, not just compliments.
- [Brand identity](https://www.fazeddigital.com/services#brand): Look as good as you actually are.
- [SEO marketing](https://www.fazeddigital.com/services#seo): Get found by people already looking for you.
- [Product design](https://www.fazeddigital.com/services#product): Apps and platforms people finish using.
- [Custom system development](https://www.fazeddigital.com/services#systems): Software that fits how your team works.
- [7-day website (USD)](https://www.fazeddigital.com/lp/7-day-website) · [Philippine pricing](https://www.fazeddigital.com/lp/7-day-website/ph)
- [Web design in Iligan City](https://www.fazeddigital.com/web-design-iligan-city): local studio in Iligan City 9200, Lanao del Norte; meets clients in person in Iligan and Cagayan de Oro; works in English, Bisaya and Tagalog.
- [Framer websites](https://www.fazeddigital.com/framer): Framer design and build (landing pages, waitlists, CMS blogs, shop pages); 9 concept builds (Suddle, Ricko, Dawdle, Stillroom, Lanewise, YOWCH, Mizzle, Softlight Dental, Tap & Switch) are fictional brands, not client work.
- [E-commerce websites](https://www.fazeddigital.com/ecommerce): online stores, buying tools (3D rug size planner, 3D tile visualiser) and store migrations; client case: The Telecom Shop, Magento to PrestaShop with zero data loss. Concept stores Madder & Weft and Salt & Kiln are fictional brands.
- [Webflow websites](https://www.fazeddigital.com/webflow): Webflow design and build (product sites, Webflow Interactions, CMS, forms); concept build Signalbox is a fictional brand, not client work.
- [Free 15-minute website check](https://www.fazeddigital.com/audit): Google Meet call, 3 fixes for more calls and enquiries; no site needed.

## Case studies
- [A Framing Company](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/01): Construction, USA, 2024. WordPress website. A website they now pitch new work with.
- [Cleen & Green](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/02): Cleaning services, Philippines, 2025. Brand identity + website. A rebrand that opened a new revenue stream.
- [CrateOnScene](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/03): Automotive events, USA, 2024. MVP platform (PWA). Idea to live platform in 5 weeks.
- [The Telecom Shop](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/04): Telco retail, Australia, 2024. Magento → PrestaShop migration. Magento to PrestaShop. Zero data loss.
- [Canwell](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/05): Health & wellness, Australia, 2024. Web platform + admin portal. The public site and its ops tool, built as one.
- [8Drive](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/06): Car rental, Philippines, 2024. Booking + fleet system. From manual bookings to one system.
- [UGLQ](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/07): Non-profit, Australia, 2024. Membership portal. One secure portal for a state-wide network.
- [QLD Law Group](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/08): Legal, Australia, 2025. Website + web app + mobile app. Three products. One client experience.
- [Dotted Studios](https://www.fazeddigital.com/work/09): Branding studio, Philippines, 2026. Website + CMS. From a dead link to a site built around the work.
